units.speaker: Anna
units.text: So that's the walk. A gold tower, a double-deck bridge, and a nightcap.

units.speaker: Ben
units.text: And a legend, a plaque, and a mayor of a street.

units.speaker: Ben
units.text: You did. It's the bet you always lose.

units.speaker: Anna
units.text: I like losing to a bridge, though.

units.speaker: Ben
units.text: Tomorrow is Friday. Another work day, and another walk in pieces, this time through the Loop.
